feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for y=0.07. Evidence: moving the sensor row from y=0.04 to y=0.06 (iterations 2 to 3) lowered oval max_error from 0.0617 to 0.0598 and raised oval progress from 0.53 to 0.87, so forward sensing is the only geometry lever that has helped the oval. The cost showed in the controller: oval steering_oscillation rose to 0.339 at iteration 3 (kp 2.2, kd 0.30). Softening the controller alone (iteration 4, kp 2.0, kd 0.35) moved oscillation only to 0.333, though that run also widened the outer pair, so the result is confounded. Outer spacing of x=±0.05 (iteration 4) cut progress to 0.80, 12 mm footprints (iteration 5) cut it to 0.73, and wheel_track 0.085 (iteration 6) cut it to 0.70, so those are rejected. Across every geometry since iteration 2, s-bend and slalom max_error has stayed at 0.061 to 0.064. Decide the next step from the race as follows. If oval progress is at or above 0.85 and oval max_error is below 0.06, but s-bend or slalom max_error stays at 0.061 or above, bend exits are not sensing-limited and geometry should stop changing. If oval steering_oscillation stays above 0.34, keep y=0.07 and raise kd in steps (0.40, then 0.45) before any further geometry change. If oval progress falls below 0.85 at y=0.07, return the row to y=0.06, the 203.20 best.
requested_changes: If oval progress is at or above 0.85 and s-bend or slalom max_error stays at 0.061 or above: hold sensor positions at y=0.07 and stop geometry changes, since bend exits have stayed at 0.061 to 0.064 across all geometries since iteration 2. Evidence: iterations 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 each left s-bend and slalom max_error in that range.

If oval progress falls below 0.85 at y=0.07: return the sensor row to y=0.06 with x=±0.04 and 16 mm footprints, the 203.20 best. Evidence: iteration 3 gave oval progress 0.87 at y=0.06, and iteration 4 showed that wider outer spacing (x=±0.05) also cut progress to 0.80.

If oval steering_oscillation stays above 0.34 at y=0.07: keep the geometry and raise controller kd in steps (0.40, then 0.45) rather than changing sensors or wheel_track. Evidence: iteration 4 softened kp and raised kd only to 0.35 and moved oscillation just from 0.339 to 0.333, so the change needs to be larger.
